The 2024 disclosure D500 describes the structured risk and control self-assessment process and the oversight role of the Operational Risk and Compliance organization. The 2025 disclosure D506 describes the CCOR organization's responsibility for providing independent, risk-based review and oversight of assessments conducted by LOBs and Corporate with respect to compliance, conduct, and operational risks. While the specific 'self-assessment' language is less explicit in D506, the core subject is the independent oversight of control assessments by the compliance/operational risk function.

comparisons.peer_summary: First-Line Units (FLUs) and control functions are responsible for managing all aspects of their businesses, including compliance and operational risk. They must understand their processes and risks, monitor controls, conduct quality assurance, adhere to risk appetite limits, and proactively identify and escalate risks to strengthen organizational resiliency.
comparisons.comparison: Both JPM and Bank of America assign primary responsibility for identifying and managing operational risk to their first-line business units and control functions through structured assessment and monitoring processes. JPM states that the 'Firm utilizes a structured risk and control self-assessment process that is executed by the LOBs and Corporate,' which evaluates control effectiveness to identify remediation needs. Similarly, BAC states that 'FLUs and control functions are first and foremost responsible for managing all aspects of their businesses, including their compliance and operational risk,' and are required to 'monitor and report on the effectiveness of the control environment' and 'conduct comprehensive quality assurance activities' to identify issues and risks. Both frameworks rely on the first line to actively assess controls and identify gaps, with BAC explicitly mentioning the requirement to identify and escalate risks.

sentences.text: The Firm utilizes a structured risk and control self-assessment process that is executed by the LOBs and Corporate.

As part of this process, the LOBs and Corporate evaluate the effectiveness of their respective control environment to assess circumstances in which controls have failed, and to determine where remediation efforts may be required.
FLUs and control functions are first and foremost responsible for managing all aspects of their businesses, including their compliance and operational risk.

FLUs and control functions are required to understand their business processes and related risks and controls, including third-party dependencies and the related regulatory requirements, and monitor and report on the effectiveness of the control environment.

In order to actively monitor and assess the performance of their processes and controls, they must conduct comprehensive quality assurance activities and identify issues and risks to remediate control gaps and weaknesses.

comparisons.peer_topic: Operational risk management framework and appetite
comparisons.peer_summary: Citi has established a global Operational Risk Management Framework via its Independent Operational Risk Management group, which defines risk appetite and utilizes a Manager's Control Assessment process for self-identification of significant risks and control performance assessment.
comparisons.comparison: Both JPM and Citi utilize a structured self-assessment process to identify operational risks and evaluate control effectiveness, though they differ in terminology and specific governance structures. JPM describes this as a 'structured risk and control self-assessment process' executed by Lines of Business (LOBs) and Corporate, with oversight by the Operational Risk and Compliance organization. Similarly, Citi utilizes a 'Manager's Control Assessment (MCA) process for self-identification of significant operational risks, assessment of the performance of key controls', established under its global Operational Risk Management Framework defined by an Independent Operational Risk Management group. Both firms rely on first-line self-assessment to identify risks, with JPM explicitly noting the evaluation of control environment effectiveness and remediation needs, while Citi links the MCA to mitigating residual risk above acceptable levels.

sentences.text: The Firm utilizes a structured risk and control self-assessment process that is executed by the LOBs and Corporate.

As part of this process, the LOBs and Corporate evaluate the effectiveness of their respective control environment to assess circumstances in which controls have failed, and to determine where remediation efforts may be required.

Citi's Independent Operational Risk Management group has established a global Operational Risk Management Framework with policies and practices for identification, measurement, monitoring, controlling and reporting operational risks and the overall operating effectiveness of the internal control environment.

As part of this framework, Citi has defined its operational risk appetite and established a Manager's Control Assessment (MCA) process for self-identification of significant operational risks, assessment of the performance of key controls and mitigation of residual risk above acceptable levels.

comparisons.peer_topic: Operational Risk Data Tools and Self-Assessment Process
comparisons.peer_summary: The Firm uses applications to capture and report operational risk data and metrics, and conducts an operational risk and control self-assessment process performed by managers to identify and rate risks and controls.
comparisons.comparison: Both JPM and Goldman Sachs describe an 'operational risk and control self-assessment process' performed by their respective business units/managers to identify risks and evaluate controls. JPM states that 'The Firm utilizes a structured risk and control self-assessment process that is executed by the LOBs and Corporate,' where these entities evaluate control effectiveness. Goldman Sachs similarly notes that one of its key tools is 'an operational risk and control self-assessment process, which is performed by our managers,' which consists of 'the identification and rating of operational risks... and the related controls.' Both disclosures highlight the self-assessment mechanism as a primary method for identifying operational risk exposures, with JPM adding that oversight is provided by the Operational Risk and Compliance organization, while GS notes the results are analyzed to identify businesses with heightened risk.

sentences.text: The Firm utilizes a structured risk and control self-assessment process that is executed by the LOBs and Corporate.

As part of this process, the LOBs and Corporate evaluate the effectiveness of their respective control environment to assess circumstances in which controls have failed, and to determine where remediation efforts may be required.
One of our key risk identification and control assessment tools is an operational risk and control self-assessment process, which is performed by our managers.
This process consists of the identification and rating of operational risks, on a forward-looking basis, and the related controls.

peer_results.rationale: While MS discusses operational risk governance and oversight, its primary disclosure (ms_2024_7_D336) focuses on the delegation of primary responsibility to business segments and control groups with designated coordinators, rather than the specific structured self-assessment process for control effectiveness evaluation that defines the JPM disclosure. The other MS disclosure (ms_2024_7_D337) focuses on independent oversight roles by specific departments (Operational Risk Department and NFR CTIS) rather than the first-line self-assessment framework used by JPM, Citi, and GS. Thus, no candidate substantively matches the specific 'risk and control self-assessment process executed by LOBs' topic of the target.
